svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, the same. Saw 10 x 6 mm bar to 200 mm; square the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay it 6 mm side down. Mark a centre line 5 mm from each edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes 4.5 mm on the centre line at 7, 25, 70, 130 and 190 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the rear end (X = -93, -75, -30, 30 and 90 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; break every edge lightly. The outer 6 mm face lines up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the long edge of the core plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay it under the plate and look through all five holes.
